criteria.1: PARTIAL: units, words (incl. Unassigned), failures, exclusions, externals and NotAssessed decomposition are accounted for, but a target without physical support cannot be represented: MappingTarget.sourceSupport is a mandatory TypedSupport (only nonempty Text/Anchored cases) and NodeSummary.support is mandatory, so 'e4 without support' and 'g1 Partial because a declared child lacks support' cannot be typed without a placeholder; the contract's support_status field is absent.
criteria.2: PARTIAL: compile-time separation and derivation of rawArgmax/decodedMass/origin are sound and FidelityStatus is apart from AlignState.mode, but (1) 'ModelPosterior.of(HsmmResult) is the only door' is false because public HsmmResult.validated accepts a caller AlignmentMatrix; (2) no codec path rebuilds ModelPosterior or FidelityStatus.Assessed; (3) GateOutcome is a public payload enum and the MappingLink factory is unspecified; (4) 'zero <=> outside candidate support' is stricter than the contract and wrong for inside-support zeros.
criteria.3: PARTIAL: policies, a StageLedger covering every stage, UnitRoles, CandidateCoverage and universe/grain are present and historical ledgers are all Unknown, but measurement_compatibility and candidate_policy_id are absent; decoding to Derived via a caller-supplied expectation is a self-certification door contradicting 'codec produces Unknown'; demoting every decoded stage to Unknown(WireAssertedOnly) breaks exact round trips; one receipt per stage with no per-channel/per-link stage or candidate-set identity.
criteria.4: PARTIAL: bundle inventory plus per-target per-axis membership is right; StoryModel untouched; the 2^53+1 decimal-string golden on three platforms is well aimed; but the real Sherlock shape has no witness (SherlockSourceAtlas binds every row's EvidenceSupport to the composed bundle, both native and composed anchors naming it), the decode binding bundle is ambiguous, and the wire's bundle/axis/coordinate_mappings sections are not enumerated.
criteria.5: PARTIAL: probe placement, positive and accepting controls present per slice; the two named falsifications are non-vacuous (e3 .9 vs e7 .4; p6 dropped); but several Slice 7 falsifiers are masked by the canonical-text guard or by checked, the round-trip court never exercises ModelPosterior, Assessed fidelity or Derived stages, and the demotion rule threatens the round-trip accepting control itself.
criteria.boundary: MET: no new module; files in recall, align, codec, laws; mapping-record/v0.1 independent of StoryModel and hsmm/v4; additive compatibility impact. SD5 requires an ADR line for the new public vocabulary and contract deviations; none is scheduled (finding).

findings.location: §3 AC2 ModelPosterior 'only door' and Fidelity 'Assessed derived only via FidelityFacets.assess'; §4 contextual decoding; §8 Slice 7
findings.issue: Derivation-only values have no decode path. ExpectedMappingContext carries RecallInventory and SourceRepresentation but no HsmmResult (the only ModelPosterior door) and no PropositionSketch/NodeSummary that FidelityFacets.assess needs (FidelityReport is itself a public case class). A decoder finishing through MappingResult.checked must either refuse every HSMM-derived record (making the Slice 6 adapter output unserializable) or add a public wire factory (defeating Slice 3 probes). The miniature round trip uses RawScores/NotAssessed/Unavailable so cannot detect either. Nothing says the 0.1 decoder refuses a calibrated value.
findings.fix: Specify the decode path per authority-bearing value: ModelPosterior decodes only when the context supplies the validated HsmmResult and is bit-equal, else refused; FidelityStatus.Assessed decodes only when the expected RecallGraph and SourceView re-derive it, else refused or decoded as a distinct wire-asserted status; Calibrated, reserved statuses and 'derived' refused in 0.1. Add a Slice 7 round-trip court over the Slice 6 historical record.

findings.location: §4 'Provenance never decodes to Derived on the wire's word' vs §3 AC3 'nothing produces it'
findings.issue: A stage decodes to Derived when an independently supplied StageLedgerExpectation matches the wire receipts, contradicting §3; nothing in G1 produces Derived so the path has no accepting control; if an expectation can be built from receipts a caller can copy the wire's receipts and certify a historical record (the self-certification ANALYSIS_CONTRACT §8 and AC3 forbid). Restoring receipts on decode belongs to bd-01M2WVFV2WGF5BVQHX7JTYYWRH (AC3).
findings.fix: In 0.1 refuse a 'derived' stage on the wire as a reserved value and decode Unknown stages unchanged; drop StageLedgerExpectation from G1; name the compatibility ticket as owner of Derived restoration; keep the mutation 'embedded receipts decode to Derived'.

findings.location: §3 AC4 MappingTarget.sourceSupport; §7 MappingContractSuite ('e4 without support', 'g1 Partial'); §6 fixture
findings.issue: Fixture e4 has null part/startTick/endTick; TypedSupport has only nonempty Text and Anchored; SourceRepresentation.of reads mandatory NodeSummary.support, so an unlocated target cannot exist without fabricated support (contract §3 source_loci: 'not fabricated placeholders'); support_status (a contract source_targets field) is omitted. Also in the RecallToVideo path NodeSummary.support is annotation text (RecallToVideo.scala:165,192) with physical loci in a side map; only SherlockAnnotationView swaps in Anchored support (SherlockRecallMapping.scala:315-317).
findings.fix: sourceSupport: SourceSupportStatus = Located(TypedSupport) | Unlocated(reason), carry support_status on the wire, take physical support from an explicit per-target input rather than assuming NodeSummary.support is physical, and add the falsifier: a mutant fabricating support for e4 must fail 'g1 is Partial'.

findings.location: §4 demotion bullet vs §8 Slice 7 accepting control
findings.issue: Decoding every stage as Unknown(WireAssertedOnly, asserted=Some(r)) plus the canonical-text guard means a ledger holding Unknown(HistoricalArtifact) re-encodes differently, so the decoder refuses its own output, breaking the miniature round-trip fixed-point control and AC5.
findings.fix: Preserve Unknown(reason, asserted) exactly on decode; refuse Derived rather than demoting it.

findings.issue: (1) 'remove version check -> v0.2 refuses' is masked by the canonical guard; (2) 'decoder accepts numeric ticks' is masked by re-encoding (and under contextual decoding there may be no tick decoder to mutate); (3) 'skip digest comparison -> foreign inventory refuses' is masked by checked's unit-set check unless the foreign inventory reuses positional unit IDs (segmenter.scala:435); (4) Slice 8 aliasing court is masked if digest is a cached lazy val.
findings.fix: Each refusal test asserts the specific CodecError/MappingRefusal (UnsupportedSchema, numeric-tick detail, DigestMismatch), not isLeft; foreign-identity fixtures share unit IDs and target refs and differ only in transcript or support; the aliasing court compares re-read values or a fresh canonical re-encoding, not a cached digest.

findings.issue: SherlockSourceAtlas.scala:130-158 binds every row's support to the composed bundle (both anchors name it), so decode must rebuild against the composed bundle (a part bundle refuses it). A corpus-intake test is infeasible (corpusIntake depends only on corpus.jvm/core.jvm, build.sbt:451) and R9 rules out embed-bench. The miniature composition control keeps support bound to part bundles so composed-bound support is never exercised. DeclaredComposition(composed, compositions) duplicates composed.mappings with no equality check.
findings.fix: State the rule: support.bundleIdentity is a listed part bundle or composition.composed; native axes resolve to the part whose primaryAxis matches; the composed primary resolves to the composition; compositions must equal composed.mappings and cover exactly the listed parts. Add an align-level synthetic Sherlock-shaped fixture from core APIs (two parts, composed bundle with TrackCompositions, composed-bound native + composed anchors, a scene spanning both parts) and the falsifier 'membership via anchor.bundle' -> parts disappear.

findings.location: §3 AC2 Measures ('ModelPosterior reachable only from a gated HsmmResult'); Slice 3 probe
findings.issue: Public HsmmResult.validated (hsmm.scala:373-384) accepts a caller AlignmentMatrix (AlignmentRow.of/AlignmentMatrix.of public), a TransitionFlow from public FlowStep, and empty costs; it checks normalization, marginals and gate admission but not that inference happened, so a row-normalized Sinkhorn plan over an Undeclared view yields a ModelPosterior. The Slice 3 probe passes while the indirect door stays open.
findings.fix: Withdraw the claim: ModelPosterior guarantees shape and gate admission only; inference authority comes from the ledger's Inference stage. Add a witness that a validated-but-not-inferred posterior carries Unknown inference provenance; list it in §11.

findings.location: §3 AC2 GateOutcome enum; MappingLink factory; D7
findings.issue: GateOutcome is a public payload enum recording a gate verdict (authority-bearing by D7). MappingLink's factory is unspecified; a public factory taking gate and fidelity lets a caller assert NoContradictionDetected without a gate or attach another unit's Assessed fidelity.
findings.fix: Public MappingLink.ungated(destination, termSupport) fixing NotGated and NotAssessed; gated links derived inside align from HsmmResult.admissibility or ModeGate plus FidelityFacets.assess on the link's own unit/node/mode; GateOutcome a sealed trait with private gated cases; probe it.

findings.issue: The contract requires only outside => exact zero with flag false (ANALYSIS_CONTRACT.md:98); inside-support zeros are legitimate (LowerIsBetter cost 0, underflow, zero-mass fill). VoyageExport.scala:116 classes fills by mass == 0 while the plan uses candidate membership. Caller-supplied candidates are not tied to the decision-basis measure's keys, so listing a fill target relabels GapFill as StructuredDecode. The decision-basis measure has no declaring field.
findings.fix: One-way rule (outside => zero); require candidates = the basis measure's source keys; add an explicit decision-basis field naming kind and channel; reconcile with the historical DecodeFilled rule and record which 'support' is meant.

findings.issue: Map[Stage, StageProvenance] holds one receipt per stage and nothing links a measure/channel/link to its receipt; contract mapping_links needs inference_stage_id and candidate_set_id per row (ANALYSIS_CONTRACT.md:88); the evidence ticket needs per-channel receipts (input, render, config, model, candidate); the compatibility ticket must detect provider/candidate substitution but StageReceipt has no provider/model identity.
findings.fix: Several receipts per stage, each with an id; links and measures carry stage and candidate-set ids; StageReceipt gets a provider/model identity field (manifest provider_and_model_identities).
